name: query.runtime.maxrow
description: Maximum rows a query may return at runtime. 0 or blank means unlimited. Lowering it truncates large query results and shows a warning in viewsheets.

name: log.detail.level
description: Global log detail level. 'debug' is verbose and can grow log storage quickly; 'off' disables logging.

name: mail.smtp.host
description: Outgoing SMTP host used for scheduled reports and alerts. A wrong value fails delivery silently until the next send.

name: security.exposedefaultorgtoall
description: Exposes the default organization's assets to all users. Changing it fires repository side effects and alters what every user can see.

name: openid.audience
description: openid.audience is the expected aud claim value that OpenIDFilterBaseFilter.createSessionFromToken requires on every verified ID token, and has no declared default.

name: openid.authorization.endpoint
description: openid.authorization.endpoint is the URL of the identity provider's OAuth 2.0 authorization endpoint — the address a user's browser is redirected to first, to begin an OpenID Connect login — and has no declared default.

name: openid.callback.url
description: openid.callback.url is not a URL on the identity provider at all — it is the context-relative path on this StyleBI server that receives the provider's redirect after login, and defaults, when unset, to /openid/login.

name: openid.client.id
description: openid.client.id is the client identifier StyleBI registered with the identity provider for this OpenID application, and has no declared default.

name: openid.client.secret
description: openid.client.secret is the client secret StyleBI presents to the identity provider's token endpoint, and has no declared default.

name: openid.group.claim
description: openid.group.claim names the ID-token claim StyleBI reads to assign StyleBI groups to a logging-in user, and has no declared default.

name: openid.issuer
description: openid.issuer is the identity provider's issuer identifier, checked against the returned ID token's iss claim after the token is already parsed — unlike the endpoint properties, it never builds a URL StyleBI calls — and has no declared default.

name: openid.jwk.cert
description: openid.jwk.cert holds a PEM-encoded certificate StyleBI parses into a local signature-verification key, used only as a fallback when openid.jwks.uri is unset, and has no declared default.

name: openid.jwks.uri
description: openid.jwks.uri is the URL of the identity provider's JSON Web Key Set — fetched only after a token comes back, to verify the token's signature, not to start the login — and has no declared default.

name: openid.name.claim
description: openid.name.claim names the ID-token claim StyleBI reads as the logging-in user's identity, and defaults, when unset, to email.

name: openid.orgid.claim
description: openid.orgid.claim names the ID-token claim StyleBI reads to place a logging-in user in a StyleBI organization, and has no declared default.

name: openid.postprocessor
description: openid.postprocessor is meant to name a class StyleBI instantiates to adjust the SRPrincipal built from an OpenID login, given the token's claims, and is unset by default.

name: openid.property.provider
description: openid.property.provider names a class StyleBI instantiates to compute the OpenID configuration for each request, overriding the stored OpenIDConfig values, and is unset by default, so no override runs.

name: openid.role.claim
description: openid.role.claim names the ID-token claim StyleBI reads to assign StyleBI roles to a logging-in user, and has no declared default.

name: openid.scopes
description: openid.scopes is the space-separated list of OAuth scopes StyleBI requests in the authorization redirect — a request parameter sent alongside the endpoint URLs, not an address or key of its own — and defaults, when unset, to openid email.

name: openid.token.endpoint
description: openid.token.endpoint is the URL of the identity provider's OAuth 2.0 token endpoint — the address this StyleBI server itself calls, server to server, to exchange an authorization code for an ID token — and has no declared default.

name: double.sso
description: double.sso is the Allow Default Form Login checkbox on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Security > SSO page — it keeps StyleBI's own login form reachable while single sign-on is active, instead of every request being handed to the SSO provider.

name: sso.custom.class
description: sso.custom.class is the fully-qualified Java class name of a custom Filter implementation, and has no declared default.

name: sso.default.roles
description: sso.default.roles is a comma-separated list of role names granted to every user on their first SSO login, and has no declared default.

name: sso.heartbeat.url
description: sso.heartbeat.url is a URL the client is told to poll to detect that an SSO session has ended elsewhere, and has no declared default.

name: sso.logout.path
description: sso.logout.path is the application path the identity provider's own single sign-out request targets, and has no declared default.

name: sso.logout.url
description: sso.logout.url is the Single Sign-Out URL the portal's and EM's Log Out control sends the browser to, and has no declared default.

name: sso.protocol.type
description: sso.protocol.type selects the active SSO mechanism. Unset or unrecognised reads as NONE, so a typo silently disables single sign-on; this catalog entry rejects one instead.

name: sso.rsa.private.key
description: sso.rsa.private.key is the Base64-encoded, master-key-encrypted RSA private key SSOTokenService uses to sign cross-app SSO JWTs, and has no declared default.

name: sso.rsa.public.key
description: sso.rsa.public.key is the Base64-encoded RSA public key paired with sso.rsa.private.key, and has no declared default.

name: stylebi.google.openid.client.id
description: stylebi.google.openid.client.id is the Client ID field on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Security > Sign In With Google page — the OAuth client ID StyleBI was issued when its Google project was registered — and has no declared default.

name: stylebi.google.openid.scopes
description: stylebi.google.openid.scopes is the Scopes field on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Security > Sign In With Google page — the OAuth scopes StyleBI asks Google for when a visitor signs in — and defaults to openid email profile.

name: onelogin.saml2.idp.entityid
description: onelogin.saml2.idp.entityid is the identity provider's SAML entity ID, checked as the issuer of every incoming SAML message, and has no declared default.

name: onelogin.saml2.idp.single_logout_service.url
description: onelogin.saml2.idp.single_logout_service.url is the identity provider's Single Logout Service endpoint — where this server sends a SAML LogoutRequest on logout — and has no declared default.

name: onelogin.saml2.idp.single_sign_on_service.url
description: onelogin.saml2.idp.single_sign_on_service.url is the identity provider's Single Sign-On Service endpoint — where this server redirects a user to start SAML login — and has no declared default.

name: onelogin.saml2.idp.x509cert
description: onelogin.saml2.idp.x509cert is the identity provider's PEM-encoded signing certificate, used to verify every SAML response and logout message it signs, and has no declared default.

name: onelogin.saml2.sp.assertion_consumer_service.url
description: onelogin.saml2.sp.assertion_consumer_service.url is the callback URL where the identity provider must POST the SAML response after login — the Assertion Consumer Service (ACS) URL — and has no declared default.

name: onelogin.saml2.sp.entityid
description: onelogin.saml2.sp.entityid is this server's SAML Service Provider entity ID, sent to the identity provider, and has no declared default.

name: saml.groups.attribute
description: saml.groups.attribute is the Group Claim field of the SAML form on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Security > SSO page — the name of the assertion attribute StyleBI reads to put a user logging in through SAML into groups — and has no declared default.

name: saml.orgid.attribute
description: saml.orgid.attribute is the Organization Id Claim field of the SAML form on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Security > SSO page — the name of the assertion attribute StyleBI reads to decide which organization a user logging in through SAML belongs to — and has no declared default.

name: saml.roles.attribute
description: saml.roles.attribute is the Role Claim field of the SAML form on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Security > SSO page — the name of the assertion attribute StyleBI reads to assign roles to a user logging in through SAML — and has no declared default.

name: auth0.client.id
description: auth0.client.id is the OAuth client identifier a legacy Auth0 installation stored, and has no declared default.

name: auth0.client.secret
description: auth0.client.secret is the OAuth client secret a legacy Auth0 installation stored, and has no declared default.

name: auth0.domain
description: auth0.domain is the Auth0 tenant domain a legacy installation stored to build its Auth0 login endpoints, and has no declared default.

name: auth0.jwk.url
description: auth0.jwk.url is the JWKS URL a legacy Auth0 installation stored, and has no declared default.

name: auth0.jwt.claim
description: auth0.jwt.claim is the ID-token claim name a legacy Auth0 installation stored as the login identity, and has no declared default.

name: auth0.logout.url
description: auth0.logout.url is the single sign-out URL a legacy Auth0 installation stored, and has no declared default.

name: auth0.openid.scope
description: auth0.openid.scope is the space-separated OAuth scope list a legacy Auth0 installation stored, and has no declared default.

name: permission.andcondition
description: permission.andcondition (source spells it permission.andCondition; PropertiesEngine lowercases the name on every read/write, same as mail.smtp.clientSecret) is the "Access requires BOTH User and Role permission" (true) vs. "EITHER" (false) switch on Enterprise Manager's repository and Security Actions permission pages, org-scoped. Read fresh from this property on every permission check (ResourcePermissionService), so it takes effect immediately with no restart. Defaults to false (EITHER) when never explicitly set; that default is computed at each read, not persisted, so a deployment that has never touched this property will not show it as an existing stored value.

name: schedule.concurrency
description: schedule.concurrency is the Maximum Concurrent Threads field under Scheduler Options on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Schedule > Settings page. It sizes the Quartz thread pool the scheduler creates. Only the lower bound is enforced (Quartz throws below 1); there is no upper bound, so raising it without also raising schedule.memory.max divides the same heap among more simultaneous tasks. Takes effect only the next time the scheduler initializes, not on a running scheduler.

name: scheduler.rmi.port
description: scheduler.rmi.port is the RMI Port Number field on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Schedule > Settings page — the port the scheduler subprocess's RMI registry binds to. The dedicated Scheduler Settings page stops a locally-managed scheduler on its OLD port before saving a change to this value; a bare property write skips that step, so a locally-managed scheduler can become unreachable until it is manually stopped and restarted at the new port. Takes effect only the next time the scheduler subprocess starts.

name: scheduler.classpath
description: scheduler.classpath is the Scheduler Classpath field on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Schedule > Settings page — the Java classpath used to launch the scheduler as a local subprocess. It is spliced onto the subprocess's -classpath argument with no format validation, so a bad value breaks only the NEXT scheduler subprocess launch (Start/Restart on the Scheduler status page), not one already running.

name: schedule.options.notificationemail
description: schedule.options.notificationemail is the Notification Email checkbox under Schedule Options on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Schedule > Settings page: whether a task author may set a per-task notification address. It is a per-task-author permission gate only, ANDed with a per-user SCHEDULE_OPTION permission check, and takes effect on the next request with no restart.

name: schedule.options.savetodisk
description: schedule.options.savetodisk is the Save to Disk checkbox under Schedule Options: whether a task author may add a save-to-disk action when composing a task. It does not disable saving in a task that already has such an action. Per-task-author permission gate only; takes effect on the next request with no restart.

name: schedule.options.emaildelivery
description: schedule.options.emaildelivery is the Email Delivery checkbox under Schedule Options: whether a task author may add an email-delivery action, and whether the viewsheet viewer's own simple-schedule dialog offers it. Per-task-author permission gate only; takes effect on the next request with no restart.

name: schedule.options.emailbrowserenable
description: schedule.options.emailbrowserenable is the Enable Email Browser checkbox under Schedule Options: whether the email fields on a scheduled task offer a directory-browse button instead of requiring addresses to be typed. Unlike its three sibling Schedule Options checkboxes, it has no accompanying per-user permission check. Takes effect on the next request with no restart.

name: schedule.options.sharetaskingroup
description: schedule.options.sharetaskingroup is the Share Tasks Between Users in Same Group checkbox under Schedule Options: whether users can see and work with tasks owned by other members of their own group. It does nothing when security is disabled, and also controls whether the Modify By Owner Only checkbox (schedule.options.deletetaskonlybyowner) is shown on the Scheduler page. Takes effect on the next permission check with no restart.

name: schedule.options.deletetaskonlybyowner
description: schedule.options.deletetaskonlybyowner is the Modify By Owner Only checkbox under Schedule Options: whether a shared task may be deleted only by its owner rather than any group member. It has no effect unless schedule.options.sharetaskingroup is also on and security is enabled. Takes effect on the next permission check with no restart.

name: schedule.memory.min
description: schedule.memory.min is the Minimum (MB) field under Memory Usage on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Schedule > Settings page, spliced into the scheduler subprocess's -Xms flag. It is never cross-validated against schedule.memory.max by the server — only the browser's form checks min <= max — so an inverted or otherwise invalid pair is accepted silently and only fails the next scheduler launch. Takes effect only the next time the scheduler subprocess starts.

name: schedule.memory.max
description: schedule.memory.max is the Maximum (MB) field under Memory Usage on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Schedule > Settings page, spliced into the scheduler subprocess's -Xmx flag. It is never cross-validated against schedule.memory.min by the server; see that property for the same hazard. Takes effect only the next time the scheduler subprocess starts.

name: schedule.save.autosuffix
description: schedule.save.autosuffix is the Save File Suffix field under Schedule Options: text appended to the base name of every file a scheduled task saves to disk, passed through MessageFormat with {0}=asset name, {1}=creation date, {2}=running principal. Takes effect on the very next save with no restart.

name: schedule.options.scheduleisdown
description: schedule.options.scheduleisdown is the Notify on Scheduler Down checkbox under Notification: whether StyleBI emails an alert when the monitor thread finds the scheduler not running. It needs schedule.status.check.email to name a recipient and a mail transport configured, or nothing is sent. Takes effect on the monitor thread's next pass (polls every ten minutes).

name: schedule.options.taskfailed
description: schedule.options.taskfailed is the Notify on Task Failure checkbox under Notification: whether StyleBI emails an alert when a scheduled task throws. It needs schedule.status.check.email to name a recipient and a mail transport configured, or nothing is sent. Takes effect on the next task failure with no restart.

name: schedule.status.check.email
description: schedule.status.check.email is the Email Addresses field under Notification: the recipient list, comma- or semicolon-separated, for both the scheduler-down and task-failure alerts. An entry may be a literal address or a user/group name; an unresolvable name is silently dropped rather than failing the send. Takes effect on the next alert with no restart.

name: schedule.status.check.email.subject
description: schedule.status.check.email.subject is the Subject field under Notification: the subject line of the scheduler-down alert only (the task-failure alert composes its own subject). Clearing the field stores an empty string rather than restoring the shipped default. Takes effect on the next scheduler-down alert.

name: schedule.status.check.email.message
description: schedule.status.check.email.message is the Message field under Notification: the body of the scheduler-down alert only (the task-failure alert composes its own body). Clearing the field stores an empty string rather than restoring the shipped default. Takes effect on the next scheduler-down alert.

name: accessibility.enabled
description: accessibility.enabled has no Enterprise Manager field: set to the exact string true, it turns on accessibility support in the Viewer, the Portal, and PDF export, and is unset by default (there is no defaults.properties entry, so an unset value reads as absent and every reader treats that as off).

name: ai.assistant.visible
description: ai.assistant.visible is the Show AI Assistant Chat Link in Navigation Bars checkbox in the AI Integration section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page.

name: ai.snapshot.count
description: ai.snapshot.count is how many AI snapshot archives StyleBI keeps before deleting the oldest.

name: always.warn.joinmaxrows
description: always.warn.joinmaxrows has no Enterprise Manager field: the Settings > All Properties default of false (from defaults.properties) makes each of the three join table lenses (regular, cross, and self join) show the "join results limited to N rows" warning only once per lens instance; setting it to the exact string true makes the same lens re-show it every time the row limit is hit again.

name: annotations.disabled
description: annotations.disabled has no Enterprise Manager field: set to the exact string true, it hides the Annotation, Annotate Cell, Annotate Component and Annotate Point actions on every viewsheet assembly's toolbar and context menu, and is unset by default (no defaults.properties entry, so an unset value reads as absent and annotations stay visible).

name: anonymous.userdata.save
description: anonymous.userdata.save is rendered as a checkbox on Enterprise Manager's Settings > All Properties page (via the properties editor's own booleanProperties list), and defaults to false: an anonymous (not-logged-in) viewer session's per-user preferences, such as whether annotations are shown, are neither loaded from nor saved to disk, only kept in memory for that request.

name: asset.backup.count
description: asset.backup.count has no Enterprise Manager field of its own: it is how many backup archives StyleBI keeps in the backup/ folder that the Back Up Now button fills, in the Data Space section of Settings > General.

name: asset.max.undoes
description: asset.max.undoes has no Enterprise Manager field: it is how many undo points StyleBI keeps for a worksheet or dashboard open in Composer, and so how far back an undo can step.

name: asset.preview.pagecount
description: asset.preview.pagecount has no Enterprise Manager field: it is how tall the previewed table is laid out in the throwaway worksheet StyleBI builds behind Show Details and Show Data — BaseTableShowDetailsService, VSChartShowDetailsService and VSChartShowDataService — and it ships as 30.

name: asset.sample.maxrows
description: asset.sample.maxrows has no Enterprise Manager field: it is the design-mode row cap a newly created dashboard or worksheet starts with — how many detail rows the sheet retrieves while it is being designed, shown on a dashboard as the Design mode sample data size field in Composer's Viewsheet Options.

name: asset.worksheet.max
description: asset.worksheet.max has no Enterprise Manager field: it is the number of runtime sheets one server node holds in memory before it starts evicting, and it ships as 500.

name: barcode.resolution
description: barcode.resolution sets the resolution StyleBI passes to the barcode-rendering library when drawing a barcode field, and it has no declared default.

name: bigdecimal.as.double
description: bigdecimal.as.double has no Enterprise Manager field: it is rendered as a checkbox on Enterprise Manager's Settings > All Properties page (as bigDecimal.as.double, the properties editor's own booleanProperties list), and defaults to true — a query result column typed BigDecimal (SQL NUMERIC/DECIMAL) is stored internally as primitive double values rather than as BigDecimal objects.

name: cache.localized.templates
description: cache.localized.templates has no Enterprise Manager field.

name: calc.change.missingaszero
description: calc.change.missingaszero has no Enterprise Manager field: it controls whether a Chart's built-in Value Change / Percent Change calculation treats a missing (no matching row) comparison value as zero, and defaults to true — its own source comment calls it "undocumented...

name: calendar.datecompare.enabled
description: calendar.datecompare.enabled is rendered as a checkbox on Enterprise Manager's Settings > All Properties page (as calendar.dateCompare.enabled, the properties editor's own booleanProperties list), and defaults to false: it shows or hides the date-range comparison toggle on a viewsheet's Calendar selection assembly.

name: chart.image.resolution
description: chart.image.resolution has no Enterprise Manager field: it is the supersampling multiplier ChartPainter.paint0 uses when rendering a chart onto an off-screen raster image rather than exporting it, and defaults to 2 (each chart is rendered at twice its pixel dimensions, then scaled down) so that fractional-pixel lines are not lost to rounding.

name: chat.app.internal.url
description: chat.app.internal.url is the AI Assistant Internal URL field in the AI Integration section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page — the server-to-server address StyleBI itself uses to reach the AI Assistant.

name: chat.app.logo.url
description: chat.app.logo.url is the AI Assistant Logo URL field in the AI Integration section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page — a custom logo image for the AI Assistant header.

name: chat.app.server.ssl.verify
description: chat.app.server.ssl.verify decides whether StyleBI verifies the AI Assistant server's TLS certificate on the connections StyleBI itself makes to it.

name: chat.app.server.url
description: chat.app.server.url is the AI Assistant Server URL field in the AI Integration section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page — the public, browser-facing address of the AI Assistant.

name: chat.app.title
description: chat.app.title is the AI Assistant Title field in the AI Integration section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page — the name shown for the assistant in its history sidebar.

name: chat.app.vendor.name
description: chat.app.vendor.name is the AI Assistant Vendor Name field in the AI Integration section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page — the vendor name shown in the assistant header.

name: cluster.pause.enabled
description: cluster.pause.enabled decides whether Enterprise Manager's Monitoring > Cluster page offers Pause/Resume controls for cluster nodes, and it is off by default.

name: comm.block.size
description: comm.block.size has no Enterprise Manager field: it is the size, in bytes, of the ByteBuffer CommUtil.createBlockBuffer allocates for reading a materialized-view block file from local disk when no caller-supplied buffer is available, and defaults to 32768 (32 KB).

name: composer.vs.create.messsage
description: composer.vs.create.messsage is the Dashboard Create Message field — spelled messsage, with three s, in the property name itself — in the Composer Messages section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation > Presentation Settings page: custom text shown in place of the default prompt on Composer's empty New tab when no dashboard has been chosen yet.

name: composer.vs.edit.messsage
description: composer.vs.edit.messsage is the Dashboard Edit Message field — spelled messsage, with three s, in the property name itself — in the Composer Messages section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation > Presentation Settings page: custom text shown in place of the default prompt on Composer's empty Edit tab when no existing dashboard has been chosen yet.

name: composer.ws.create.messsage
description: composer.ws.create.messsage is the Data Worksheet Create Message field — spelled messsage, with three s, in the property name itself — in the Composer Messages section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation > Presentation Settings page: custom text shown in place of the default prompt on Composer's empty New tab when no data worksheet has been chosen yet.

name: composer.ws.edit.messsage
description: composer.ws.edit.messsage is the Data Worksheet Edit Message field — spelled messsage, with three s, in the property name itself — in the Composer Messages section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation > Presentation Settings page: custom text shown in place of the default prompt on Composer's empty Edit tab when no existing data worksheet has been chosen yet.

name: crossjoin.maxcellcount
description: crossjoin.maxcellcount has no Enterprise Manager field: it is the hard limit on a cross join's total cell count — left row count times right row count times the combined column count of both sides — and defaults to 50000000.

name: crosstab.datetime.expandall.level
description: crosstab.datetime.expandall.level has no Enterprise Manager field: it is the deepest date level a cube-bound crosstab's date or datetime dimension may reach when a user drills down or expands all, and defaults to DayOfMonth.

name: csrf.filter.enabled
description: csrf.filter.enabled has no Enterprise Manager field: it is the switch for StyleBI's cross-site request forgery protection, and it is true unless set, so the protection is on out of the box.

name: csv.import.max
description: csv.import.max is the maximum size, in bytes, StyleBI accepts for a file uploaded as a CSV (or other delimited-text) import — unset by default, so no cap applies unless a value is set.

name: dashboard.enabled
description: dashboard.enabled is the Enable Dashboard checkbox in the Dashboard section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page, and defaults.properties declares it true.

name: dashboard.mydashboard.disabled
description: dashboard.mydashboard.disabled hides the My Dashboard folder from the repository tree, and defaults.properties declares it false.

name: dashboard.tabs.top
description: dashboard.tabs.top is the Dashboard Tabs Top checkbox in the Dashboard section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page, and defaults.properties declares it true.

name: data.cache.file.limit
description: data.cache.file.limit has no Enterprise Manager field: it bounds, in bytes, how large StyleBI lets the on-disk data cache directory grow before old files are deleted.

name: data.temp.file.threshold
description: data.temp.file.threshold has no Enterprise Manager field: it is the size, in bytes, past which a binary payload StyleBI is transferring is written to a temporary file instead of held in memory.

name: datasource.cache.parameters
description: datasource.cache.parameters decides whether StyleBI skips re-prompting for a data source's connection parameters (such as a login) when a different user reuses a session that already connected to that data source.

name: datasource.clouderror
description: datasource.clouderror is extra text an operator can supply to append to the message a user sees whenever a database connection fails, with no Enterprise Manager control.

name: db.casesensitive
description: db.casesensitive is rendered as a checkbox on Enterprise Manager's Settings > All Properties page (as db.caseSensitive, the properties editor's own booleanProperties list), and defaults to false.

name: debug.data
description: debug.data has no Enterprise Manager field: set to the exact string true, it forces every query and viewsheet data read this server performs to skip whatever cache would otherwise answer it.

name: debug.endpoints
description: debug.endpoints has no Enterprise Manager field: set to the exact string true, it makes each REST connector datasource re-read its endpoints.json definitions from source on every query, instead of the copy parsed once when the connector class loaded — but only when the running classfile happens to sit under a runner/build/plugins path, a build-plugin sandbox layout, not a packaged install.

name: debug.json
description: debug.json has no Enterprise Manager field: set to the exact string true, it saves a copy of every REST connector's raw JSON response body to a temporary file before parsing it, for inspection.

name: debug.scheduler
description: debug.scheduler has no Enterprise Manager field: set to the exact string true, it makes the scheduler subprocess start with a remote-debug agent listening, so a developer can attach a debugger to it.

name: debug.viewsheet
description: debug.viewsheet has no Enterprise Manager field: set to the exact string true, it turns on a diagnostic aid for a specific class of bug — an assembly that goes missing from a viewsheet and is then looked up by name and not found — by recording removals and dumping a thread state file the next time that lookup misses and something elsewhere logs a NullPointerException.

name: default.data.cycle
description: default.data.cycle names the data cycle that Enterprise Manager's Materialized Views settings treat as the default one for scheduling and analysis, and it has no declared default.

name: default.font.family
description: default.font.family names the font family StyleBI treats as its own default typeface, and it is Roboto by default.

name: distincttablelens.maxrow
description: distincttablelens.maxrow has no Enterprise Manager field.

name: distributed.table.cache.flush.timeout.seconds
description: distributed.table.cache.flush.timeout.seconds has no Enterprise Manager field: it is the number of seconds a node will spend copying its local query-result cache into the shared distributed store before giving up, and it is 90 unless set.

name: drill.tabs.top
description: drill.tabs.top is the Drill Tabs Top checkbox in the Dashboard section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation > Presentation Settings page, and defaults to false: it places a report or dashboard's drill-down result tabs at the top of the display instead of their normal position.

name: em.home.link
description: em.home.link is the EM Home Link field in the Portal Integration section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page — the URL or relative path Enterprise Manager's top navigation bar's Home link points to — and defaults.properties declares it empty.

name: em.locale
description: em.locale is a fallback locale DataSourceBrowserService.getLocale uses to localise catalog strings when the caller's own Principal cannot supply one, and defaults.properties declares it empty.

name: em.mail.defaultemailfromself
description: em.mail.defaultemailfromself decides whether an email dialog — export by email, share by email, a schedule task's status-check or notification email — pre-fills the From address with the current user's own email instead of the system's configured mail.from.address, and defaults.properties declares it true.

name: excel.import.max
description: excel.import.max is the maximum size, in bytes, StyleBI accepts for a file uploaded as an Excel import — unset by default, so no cap applies unless a value is set.

name: excel.sheet.maxrows
description: excel.sheet.maxrows caps how many rows a single Excel worksheet may hold when StyleBI exports a dashboard to Excel — unset by default, so an export has no row limit unless a value is set.

name: excel.table.datatab
description: excel.table.datatab controls whether StyleBI's Excel export adds a second, unformatted sheet holding a table's full underlying data alongside its formatted one — enabled by default, so an export gets the extra sheet unless the property is explicitly turned off.

name: excel.vs.export.grid.show
description: excel.vs.export.grid.show controls whether StyleBI's Excel export shows Excel's own cell gridlines on the generated sheet — off by default, so exported sheets show no gridlines unless the property is turned on.

name: export.csv.delimiter
description: export.csv.delimiter sets the field delimiter used when a worksheet is exported to CSV, and CSVWSExporter.write falls back to a comma when it is unset.

name: export.expandcomponents
description: export.expandcomponents is the deployment-wide default for whether a viewsheet export "expands components" — writes overflowing table rows in full rather than clipping each table to its print layout region — and defaults.properties declares it false.

name: filename.strict
description: filename.strict has no Enterprise Manager field: it controls how permissive Tool.toFileName is when sanitizing a string into a safe filename, and defaults to true — only letters and digits survive; everything else is replaced.

name: filter.debug
description: filter.debug has no Enterprise Manager field: it turns on extra diagnostic logging in two unrelated internal table-filtering classes, XSwappableObjectList (the swap-to-disk backing store for large in-memory table data) and AbstractConditionFilter (the base class for row-condition table filters), and defaults to false.

name: flash.wmode
description: flash.wmode has no Enterprise Manager field: it is a legacy value, from when the Portal welcome page could embed a Flash object, that HTMLUtil.copyTemplate makes available to a custom welcome page HTML template as the WMODE template variable.

name: font.afm.path
description: font.afm.path is the AFM Font Path field in the PDF Generation section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation > Presentation Settings page — a ;-separated list of directories FontManager scans for Adobe Font Metrics (.afm) files, declared in defaults.properties as an empty string, so it ships with no directories configured.

name: font.cmap.path
description: font.cmap.path has no Enterprise Manager field.

name: font.metrics.source
description: font.metrics.source has no Enterprise Manager field.

name: font.preload
description: font.preload has no Enterprise Manager field.

name: font.ratio.x
description: font.ratio.x has no Enterprise Manager field.

name: font.ratio.y
description: font.ratio.y has no Enterprise Manager field.

name: font.truetype.path
description: font.truetype.path is the CID Font Path field in the PDF Generation section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation > Presentation Settings page — a ;-separated list of directories FontManager scans for TrueType/OpenType font files, with a declared default of c:/winnt/fonts;c:/windows/fonts;$(sree.home)/fonts.

name: format.auto.downgrade
description: format.auto.downgrade has no Enterprise Manager field.

name: format.date
description: format.date is the Date Format field in the General Format section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation > Presentation Settings page — the pattern StyleBI uses to render Date values with no format of their own, defaulting to yyyy-MM-dd.

name: format.date.time
description: format.date.time is the Date/Time Format field in the General Format section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation > Presentation Settings page — the pattern StyleBI uses to render Timestamp and combined date-time values with no format of their own, defaulting to yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.

name: format.number
description: format.number has no Enterprise Manager field.

name: format.number.round
description: format.number.round has no Enterprise Manager field.

name: format.percent.round
description: format.percent.round has no Enterprise Manager field.

name: format.time
description: format.time is the Time Format field in the General Format section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation > Presentation Settings page — the pattern StyleBI uses to render Time values and schedule times with no format of their own, defaulting to HH:mm:ss.

name: formula.avg.keep.type
description: formula.avg.keep.type makes the AVG aggregate formula return a result in the input column's own numeric type — an average of integers stays an integer — matching how SQL's own AVG behaves, instead of StyleBI's default of always producing a double.

name: formula.min.number
description: formula.min.number decides whether the MIN aggregate formula compares two string values as numbers when they look like numbers, rather than as plain text.

name: formula.parse.number
description: formula.parse.number decides whether the MAX and NthLargest aggregate formulas compare two string values as numbers when they look like numbers, rather than as plain text.

name: fs.desktop
description: fs.desktop puts the materialized-view file system in desktop mode, in which a materialized view's data is kept whole instead of being divided into block files that can be built and read in parallel.

name: getting.started
description: getting.started has no Enterprise Manager field: its own code comment calls it a testing hook that bypasses the Portal's normal per-user "show the Getting Started dialog once" logic.

name: global.parameter.provider
description: global.parameter.provider has no Enterprise Manager field: it names the fully-qualified Java class of a custom GlobalParameterProvider implementation, an extension point for supplying global (cross-report) prompted parameters when a report or viewsheet is opened.

name: google.maps.key
description: google.maps.key is the API Key field, shown only when Web Map Service is set to Google Maps, in the Web Map Configuration section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation > Presentation Settings page.

name: googlemaps.max.size
description: googlemaps.max.size has no Enterprise Manager field: it is the largest pixel dimension (width or height) GoogleMapsService will request a Google Static Maps background image at, and defaults to 640 — matching the Google Static Maps API's own free-tier image size limit.

name: graph.3dbar.maxcount
description: graph.3dbar.maxcount is the largest number of data rows StyleBI will draw shapes for on 3D Bar and 3D Stack Bar charts, beyond which the chart is truncated.

name: graph.3dpie.maxcount
description: graph.3dpie.maxcount is the largest number of data rows StyleBI will draw shapes for on 3D Pie charts, beyond which the chart is truncated.

name: graph.area.maxcount
description: graph.area.maxcount is the largest number of data rows StyleBI will draw shapes for on Area, Stack Area, Step Area and Stack Step Area charts, beyond which the chart is truncated.

name: graph.axis.inplot
description: graph.axis.inplot reserves room for the outermost axis label so it does not have to be shifted to fit inside the plot.

name: graph.axislabel.maxcount
description: graph.axislabel.maxcount is the largest number of distinct values StyleBI will keep for a categorical or time axis.

name: graph.bar.maxcount
description: graph.bar.maxcount is the largest number of data rows StyleBI will draw shapes for on Bar and Stack Bar charts, beyond which the chart is truncated.

name: graph.candle.maxcount
description: graph.candle.maxcount is the largest number of data rows StyleBI will draw shapes for on Candle charts, beyond which the chart is truncated.

name: graph.circle.packing
description: graph.circle.packing chooses how a Circle Packing chart fills its plot area.

name: graph.fm.uniform
description: graph.fm.uniform has no Enterprise Manager field: it makes chart text on screen use the same font metrics StyleBI uses when generating PDF, and it is false unless set.

name: graph.ggraph.maxcount
description: graph.ggraph.maxcount bounds how many nested geometry graphs one chart may build — one per coordinate, so a facet multiplies them.

name: graph.legend.maxcount
description: graph.legend.maxcount is the largest number of entries StyleBI will build for a chart legend.

name: graph.line.maxcount
description: graph.line.maxcount is the largest number of data rows StyleBI will draw shapes for on Line, Stack Line, Step Line, Stack Step Line and Jump Line charts, beyond which the chart is truncated.

name: graph.max.nodes
description: graph.max.nodes is the largest number of nodes StyleBI will lay out in a relation chart — the Tree, Network and Circular Network types.

name: graph.pareto.maxcount
description: graph.pareto.maxcount is the largest number of data rows StyleBI will draw shapes for on Pareto charts, beyond which the chart is truncated.

name: graph.pie.maxcount
description: graph.pie.maxcount is the largest number of data rows StyleBI will draw shapes for on Pie, Donut, Sunburst, Treemap, Circle Packing and Icicle charts, beyond which the chart is truncated.

name: graph.point.maxcount
description: graph.point.maxcount is the largest number of data rows StyleBI will draw shapes for on Point and Stack Point charts — and on most Map charts' point layers — beyond which the chart is truncated.

name: graph.radar.maxcount
description: graph.radar.maxcount is the largest number of data rows StyleBI will draw shapes for on Radar and Filled Radar charts, beyond which the chart is truncated.

name: graph.script.action.support
description: graph.script.action.support keeps chart actions working on a chart whose structure a script has changed.

name: graph.stock.maxcount
description: graph.stock.maxcount is the largest number of data rows StyleBI will draw shapes for on Stock charts, beyond which the chart is truncated.

name: graph.subgraph.maxcount
description: graph.subgraph.maxcount bounds how many sub-graphs a faceted chart may create.

name: graph.textlayout.maxcount
description: graph.textlayout.maxcount is the number of text labels above which StyleBI stops trying to resolve overlaps between them.

name: graph.textlayout.maxstep
description: graph.textlayout.maxstep is how many positions StyleBI will try in each direction when moving a chart label out from under another.

name: graph.waterfall.maxcount
description: graph.waterfall.maxcount is the largest number of data rows StyleBI will draw shapes for on Waterfall charts, beyond which the chart is truncated.

name: graphics.image.scalesmooth
description: graphics.image.scalesmooth has no Enterprise Manager field: it controls how an embedded image is resized when its target display size differs from its native size, and is unset by default — resizing uses each renderer's own faster, lower-quality scaling instead of an explicit smooth resample.

name: grid.min.height
description: grid.min.height has no Enterprise Manager field: it is the minimum height, in points, a classic Report's tabular grid layout (TabularSheet) gives a row, and defaults to 10.

name: health.cacheswap.excessivewaitingthreads
description: health.cacheswap.excessivewaitingthreads has no Enterprise Manager field: it is how many threads may be blocked waiting on the cache swapper for memory before StyleBI starts timing the condition.

name: health.filesystem.enabled
description: health.filesystem.enabled has no Enterprise Manager field: it is the switch that turns on StyleBI's file-system health check, which tries to read the attributes of each path in health.filesystem.paths and reports the server DOWN if any of them cannot be reached.

name: health.reportfailure.threshold
description: health.reportfailure.threshold has no Enterprise Manager field: it is the number of distinct assets that may currently be in a failed state before StyleBI reports the server DOWN, and it defaults to 20.

name: health.securityproviders.enabled
description: health.securityproviders.enabled has no Enterprise Manager field: it is the switch that turns on StyleBI's security-provider health check, which asks each authentication provider in the chain whether it is reachable, reporting the server DOWN if one is not.

name: help.url
description: help.url has no dedicated Enterprise Manager field: it is the base URL every contextual help link in Enterprise Manager, the Composer, the script editor, and the Portal's own Help menu item is built from, and defaults to the empty string — which falls back to InetSoft's own hosted documentation site.

name: helper.map.max
description: helper.map.max has no Enterprise Manager field: it is the maximum number of entries ReportHelper's version-helper class-name cache holds before trimming, and defaults to 120.

name: html.character.encode
description: html.character.encode is the character encoding the portal's welcome page is written and declared with, and the charset used to URL-decode classpath entries when StyleBI assembles the schedule server's classpath.

name: html.loading.icon
description: html.loading.icon replaces the file served as the portal's loading spinner.

name: htmlpresenter.fitline
description: htmlpresenter.fitline is rendered as a checkbox on Enterprise Manager's Settings > All Properties page (the properties editor's own booleanProperties list), and defaults to true: a classic Report's HTML Presenter cell (a report element that renders formatted HTML content) that would otherwise be cut off mid-page breaks at the nearest line boundary above the cut, instead of mid-line.

name: http.session.maxperclient
description: http.session.maxperclient is the maximum number of simultaneous sessions one client — a given user and host — may hold.

name: http.session.maxwebsocketperuser
description: http.session.maxwebsocketperuser is the maximum number of WebSocket connections a single HTTP session may hold open, beyond which a further upgrade request is refused.

name: http.session.timeout
description: http.session.timeout is how long, in seconds, a user's HTTP session survives without activity before StyleBI expires it and returns the user to the login screen.

name: hyperlink.indicator
description: hyperlink.indicator is rendered as a checkbox on Enterprise Manager's Settings > All Properties page (the properties editor's own booleanProperties list), and defaults to true: a cell or chart element that carries a hyperlink is underlined to indicate it is clickable.

name: ignore.swapper.memory.state
description: ignore.swapper.memory.state has no declared default and no Enterprise Manager field; unset, it reads as null, which is not the literal string "true", so its effect — suppressing the BUSY status this server reports for itself — stays off by default.

name: image.antialias
description: image.antialias turns on Java2D anti-aliased rendering (RenderingHints.KEY_ANTIALIASING) when StyleBI paints a chart or shape to an image, and defaults.properties declares it true.

name: image.filtered
description: image.filtered turns on per-scanline PNG filtering when StyleBI encodes an image to PNG, and defaults.properties declares it false.

name: image.png.alpha
description: image.png.alpha is the default alpha (transparency) flag Common.writePNG uses when it encodes an image to PNG and the caller has not specified one explicitly, and defaults.properties declares it false.

name: inbound.channel.pool.size
description: inbound.channel.pool.size has no declared default; unset, WebSocketConfig.getEventThreadPoolSize falls back to Runtime.getRuntime().availableProcessors()  8.

name: inetsoft.sree.security.userprovider
description: inetsoft.sree.security.userprovider has no Enterprise Manager field: it is the fully qualified class name of an inetsoft.sree.security.UserProvider implementation that supplies user information from an external source when StyleBI is running under SSO.

name: inetsoft.uql.jdbc.connectionpoolfactory
description: inetsoft.uql.jdbc.connectionpoolfactory has no Enterprise Manager field: it is the fully qualified class name of the inetsoft.uql.jdbc.ConnectionPoolFactory implementation that supplies the DataSource for every JDBC data source — your own class, or one of the two the product ships.

name: input.autorefresh.defaultvalue
description: input.autorefresh.defaultvalue has no declared default; InputVSAssemblyInfo falls back to "true" when it is unset.

name: java.version
description: java.version has no declared default and no code path anywhere writes it into StyleBI's property store, so SreeEnv.getProperty("java.version") returns null on every real install.

name: javascript.getimagefunction.disabled
description: javascript.getimagefunction.disabled turns off the getImage() function available to StyleBI formula and expression scripts, with no Enterprise Manager control.

name: javascript.java.com_org
description: javascript.java.com_org controls whether StyleBI formula and expression scripts can reach any Java class whose package starts with com.

name: javascript.legacy.compatibility
description: javascript.legacy.compatibility gates a compatibility shim that restores the old Rhino-era Java-interop syntax in StyleBI's formula and expression scripts — package-root navigation (java.awt.Color), constructor calls without new (java.awt.Color(0xaed581)), static member access, and importClass/importPackage.

name: jdbc.blob.type
description: jdbc.blob.type has no Enterprise Manager field: it decides whether StyleBI reads binary database columns as images or as text.

name: jdbc.connection.jndi.prefix
description: jdbc.connection.jndi.prefix has no Enterprise Manager field: it is the path prepended to a data source's name when StyleBI looks that data source up in JNDI.

name: jdbc.connection.pool
description: jdbc.connection.pool has no Enterprise Manager field: it is the fully qualified class name of the connection pool implementation StyleBI uses for every JDBC data source.

name: jdbc.fetch.size
description: jdbc.fetch.size has no Enterprise Manager field: it is the JDBC fetch size StyleBI sets on every statement it executes, the number of rows the driver is asked to bring back per round trip.

name: join.table.forcehash
description: join.table.forcehash forces StyleBI's in-memory table join to always use a hash-based join strategy, and it is off by default.

name: join.table.maxrows
description: join.table.maxrows caps how many rows a single table join may produce, and it is unset by default, which is treated as unlimited.

name: legacy.excel.largetable.export
description: legacy.excel.largetable.export has no declared default; unset or any value other than the literal "true" leaves the newer behavior active.

name: limit.alias.length
description: limit.alias.length declares an empty default in defaults.properties, which is not the literal "true", so alias-length limiting is off by default for the dialects that consult it.

name: local.host.name
description: local.host.name manually overrides the host name StyleBI reports for the machine it is running on, and it has no declared default.

name: local.ip.addr
description: local.ip.addr manually overrides the IP address StyleBI reports for the machine it is running on, and it has no declared default.

name: locale.available
description: locale.available lists the locale codes StyleBI offers as language choices, colon-separated, and it is unset by default, which every reader treats as "just the JVM's own default locale."

name: log.file.discriminator
description: log.file.discriminator is the string a cluster node stamps into its own log file names, with no declared default — every reader falls back to this node's own IP address when unset, and there is no Enterprise Manager control for it.

name: log.fluentd.connecttimeout
description: log.fluentd.connecttimeout is the Connect Timeout field on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Logging page — the milliseconds StyleBI waits when connecting to the Fluentd/Fluent Bit collector — with no declared default, falling back to 10000 (ten seconds).

name: log.fluentd.host
description: log.fluentd.host is the Host field on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Logging page — the hostname or IP address of the Fluentd/Fluent Bit collector StyleBI forwards log records to — with no declared default, falling back to localhost.

name: log.fluentd.logviewurl
description: log.fluentd.logviewurl is the Log View URL field on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Logging page — the external link StyleBI shows for viewing logs at the collector's own UI — read only while log.provider is the exact literal fluentd, with no declared default, so unset shows no link.

name: log.fluentd.orgadminaccess
description: log.fluentd.orgadminaccess is the Allow organization administrators to access logging checkbox on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Logging page, shown only when the server is multi-tenant and log.provider is fluentd; ActionPermissionService.isOrgAdminAction reads it to decide whether organization admins everywhere get the monitoring/log viewing permission, with no declared default, so unset behaves as off.

name: log.fluentd.port
description: log.fluentd.port is the Port field on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Logging page — the TCP port the Fluentd/Fluent Bit collector listens on — with no declared default, falling back to 24224, Fluentd's own default port.

name: log.fluentd.security.userauthenticationenabled
description: log.fluentd.security.userauthenticationenabled is the User Authentication Enabled checkbox on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Logging page — it turns on username/password authentication in addition to the shared key when StyleBI connects to the Fluentd/Fluent Bit collector — with no declared default, so unset behaves as off.

name: log.fluentd.security.username
description: log.fluentd.security.username is the Username field on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Logging page — the account name StyleBI presents when authenticating to the Fluentd/Fluent Bit collector — with no declared default.

name: log.fluentd.securityenabled
description: log.fluentd.securityenabled is the Security Enabled checkbox on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Logging page — it turns on shared-key (and optionally username/password) authentication when StyleBI connects to the Fluentd/Fluent Bit collector — with no declared default, so unset behaves as off.

name: log.fluentd.tls.cacertificatefile
description: log.fluentd.tls.cacertificatefile is the CA Certificate File field on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Logging page — the filesystem path to the CA certificate StyleBI trusts when connecting to the Fluentd/Fluent Bit collector over TLS.

name: log.fluentd.tlsenabled
description: log.fluentd.tlsenabled is the TLS Enabled checkbox on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Logging page — it turns on an encrypted connection when StyleBI forwards log records to the Fluentd/Fluent Bit collector — with no declared default of its own, so unset is off.

name: log.level.inetsoft.performance
description: log.level.inetsoft.performance turns on StyleBI's performance log — the per-asset execution timings recorded by LogUtil.logPerformance — and is OFF by default, so nothing is written until it is raised.

name: log.message.pattern
description: log.message.pattern is the Logback layout pattern StyleBI writes each log-file and console line with — the string every non-Fluentd appender's encoder uses — defaulting to %d %level %property{LOCAL_IP_ADDR} [%mdc] %c{1}: %message %n%ex, the exact literal StyleBI's own LogbackInitializer hard-codes for its pre-Spring startup encoder.

name: log.output.file
description: log.output.file is the base path StyleBI's main server log is written to — the appender inserts -<log.file.discriminator>, defaulting to this node's IP address, before the extension, so a value of sree.log produces sree-<discriminator>.log on disk and sree.log itself never exists — shown read-only in the Log File field on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Logging page — defaulting to sree.log.

name: log.output.stderr
description: log.output.stderr is the Output to standard output checkbox on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Logging page — it also echoes log records to the console, in addition to the log file — defaulting to true.

name: log.provider
description: log.provider is the Log Type field on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Logging page that decides where StyleBI sends log records — its own log files, or a Fluent Bit/Fluentd collector — with no declared default, so unset behaves as file logging.

name: mail.attachment.maxbytes
description: mail.attachment.maxbytes is the maximum size, in bytes, of the file StyleBI inlines into an MHTML message body.

name: mail.from.address
description: mail.from.address is the default 'From' email address StyleBI uses when sending mail, and it defaults to reportserver@inetsoft.com.

name: mail.from.enabled
description: mail.from.enabled controls whether a user can type a custom 'From' address when scheduling or emailing a viewsheet, instead of being limited to their own account email; mail.from.enabled defaults to false (not editable).

name: mail.history.enabled
description: mail.history.enabled controls whether StyleBI remembers and autocompletes previously used email addresses in email/share dialogs; mail.history.enabled has no default in defaults.properties, so it behaves as disabled until an operator turns it on.

name: mail.jndi.url
description: mail.jndi.url is the JNDI name of a pre-configured javax.mail.Session StyleBI should use to send mail, instead of building one from the mail.smtp.

name: mail.mime.charset
description: mail.mime.charset is the character encoding StyleBI uses for outgoing mail MIME content; mail.mime.charset has no configured default, and when it is unset StyleBI falls back to the JVM's platform default charset.

name: mail.notification.subject.format
description: mail.notification.subject.format is the subject-line template for scheduled-task notification emails (the emails sent to task owners about task status, as opposed to delivered report emails); mail.notification.subject.format defaults to the empty string.

name: mail.smtp.authuri
description: mail.smtp.authuri is the OAuth2 authorization endpoint URI used to obtain SMTP access when mail.smtp.auth is saslXOauth2; mail.smtp.authuri has no configured default.

name: mail.smtp.clientid
description: mail.smtp.clientid is the OAuth2 client id StyleBI presents when authenticating SMTP with saslXOauth2 or googleAuth; mail.smtp.clientid has no configured default.

name: mail.smtp.oauthflags
description: mail.smtp.oauthflags holds the SMTP OAuth2 flags entered in the OAuth Flags field of the Email section on Settings > General.

name: mail.smtp.oauthscopes
description: mail.smtp.oauthscopes holds the OAuth2 scope string StyleBI requests when authorizing SMTP with SASL XOAuth2; mail.smtp.oauthscopes has no configured default and round-trips correctly through Enterprise Manager (unlike its neighbor mail.smtp.oauthflags).

name: mail.smtp.outhflags
description: mail.smtp.outhflags is a misspelled legacy property name that Mailer.getSmtpOAuthFlags still reads as a migration fallback for the OAuth Flags setting; mail.smtp.outhflags has no configured default, no code stores a value under it, and saving the Email section deletes it.

name: mail.smtp.port
description: mail.smtp.port overrides the SMTP port StyleBI connects to; mail.smtp.port has no configured default, so when it is unset the standard JavaMail default applies (25 for plain SMTP, 465 for SMTPS).

name: mail.smtp.ssl.protocols
description: mail.smtp.ssl.protocols overrides the SSL/TLS protocol list StyleBI's SMTP connection will negotiate; mail.smtp.ssl.protocols has no configured default, so when it is unset JavaMail's own default protocol list applies.

name: mail.smtp.tokenexpiration
description: mail.smtp.tokenexpiration is the epoch-millisecond timestamp when mail.smtp.accesstoken expires; mail.smtp.tokenexpiration has no configured default and is populated automatically, not typed in.

name: mail.smtp.tokenuri
description: mail.smtp.tokenuri is the OAuth2 token endpoint URL StyleBI calls to refresh the SMTP access token when mail.smtp.auth is saslXOauth2; mail.smtp.tokenuri has no configured default.

name: mail.smtp.user
description: mail.smtp.user is the SMTP account username (or the SASL XOAuth2/Google OAuth2 identity) StyleBI authenticates with when sending mail; mail.smtp.user defaults to the empty string.

name: mail.ssl
description: mail.ssl selects whether StyleBI connects to the SMTP server over implicit SSL (smtps) instead of plain SMTP; mail.ssl defaults to false.

name: mail.subject.format
description: mail.subject.format is a java.text.MessageFormat pattern used to build the subject line of emailed and scheduled viewsheet mail; mail.subject.format defaults to the empty string.

name: mail.tls
description: mail.tls selects whether StyleBI issues a STARTTLS command when connecting to the SMTP server; mail.tls has no entry in defaults.properties, and unset behaves as false (no STARTTLS).

name: map.border.color
description: map.border.color sets the outline color drawn around polygon (region/shape) map elements in a chart — geographic maps such as filled countries or states — and has no declared default, so GraphUtil.getMapBorderColor returns null when it is unset.

name: map.default.color
description: map.default.color sets the fill color for map shapes that contain data — a filled country or region on a geographic chart — and has no declared default, so GraphUtil.getMapDefaultColor falls back to a coded constant, MAP_DEFAULT_COLOR (#FBD29A), whenever the property is unset or its value cannot be parsed as a color.

name: map.empty.color
description: map.empty.color sets the fill color for map shapes that have no matching data — a country or region on a geographic chart with nothing bound to it — and has no declared default, so GraphUtil.getMapEmptyColor falls back to a coded constant, MAP_EMPTY_DATA_COLOR (#F2EFE9), whenever the property is unset or its value cannot be parsed as a color.

name: map.selection.enabled
description: map.selection.enabled controls whether a viewer can select a region on a map-type chart — click or drag a shape to highlight it — and defaults.properties declares it true.

name: mapbox.style
description: mapbox.style is the Mapbox Style dropdown in the Web Map section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page — the Mapbox map style ID web-map tiles are rendered with — and it has no declared default.

name: mapbox.user
description: mapbox.user is the User field in the Web Map section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page — the Mapbox account username StyleBI authenticates web-map tile requests as — and it has no declared default.

name: max.cell.size
description: max.cell.size is the Max Cell Size entry an administrator can add to the Properties table when editing an organization on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Security > Users page.

name: max.col.count
description: max.col.count is the Max Column Count entry an administrator can add to the Properties table when editing an organization on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Security > Users page.

name: max.row.count
description: max.row.count is the Max Row Count entry an administrator can add to the Properties table when editing an organization on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Security > Users page.

name: max.user.count
description: max.user.count is the Max User Count entry an administrator can add to the Properties table when editing an organization on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Security > Users page.

name: metric.cacheswap.excessivewaitingthreads
description: metric.cacheswap.excessivewaitingthreads sets the number of threads waiting on the swap cache that StyleBI treats as maximum load for its autoscaling signal, and it is 10 by default.

name: mixed.bidi.enabled
description: mixed.bidi.enabled has no declared default; unset, mixed-direction text renders as a single string in generated PDFs.

name: modeltrap.context.debug
description: modeltrap.context.debug turns on console tracing for the logical data model "trap" detector — the chasm-trap/fan-trap analysis that warns when a data model's join graph can double-count or drop rows — and it is off by default.

name: modeltrap.helper.debug
description: modeltrap.helper.debug turns on console tracing for the table-relationship traversal the logical data model's chasm-trap/fan-trap detector walks, and it is off by default.

name: monitor.dataset.size
description: monitor.dataset.size caps how many historical data points Enterprise Manager's monitoring pages keep for server and cluster status metrics, and it is 300 by default.

name: mv.benchmark
description: mv.benchmark turns on timing instrumentation around materialized-view query execution, recording how long each named stage took and how many rows it handled, and appending the results to CSV files in the StyleBI home directory.

name: mv.cache.association
description: mv.cache.association stops StyleBI defining a materialized view for selection associations — the greying-out of selection-list values that have no matching rows.

name: mv.cache.data
description: mv.cache.data decides whether result sets that came from a materialized view may be held in the shared data cache, where dashboards using the same data reuse one copy.

name: mv.debug
description: mv.debug turns on detailed logging about why a dashboard query was or was not served by a materialized view — which groups could not be merged, what the transformer produced, which table the query ended up against.

name: mv.detail.data
description: mv.detail.data decides whether detail data — the row-level data behind a chart or table, shown by Show Details and by drilling into a summary — is served from the materialized view or read from the source.

name: mv.dim.max.size
description: mv.dim.max.size is how many distinct values a dimension column may have before a materialized view stops supporting grouping and filtering on it.

name: mv.dispatcher.count
description: mv.dispatcher.count is how many parallel workers StyleBI uses to build one materialized view — both the size of the thread pool and the number of slices the source data is split into.

name: mv.dispatcher.interval
description: mv.dispatcher.interval is how many months of data each parallel worker takes when a materialized view is built in slices and the column it is split on is a date.

name: mv.dispatcher.number.maximum
description: mv.dispatcher.number.maximum is the highest value StyleBI assumes a numeric split column holds when it divides a materialized-view build between parallel workers — the range that gets cut into one slice per worker.

name: mv.double.precision
description: mv.double.precision decides whether numeric measures are stored in a materialized view at double precision or single.

name: mv.enabled.all
description: mv.enabled.all is the Enable MV On-demand by Default checkbox in the Materialized View section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > General page — the initial value of the per-dashboard Create MV On-demand flag for dashboards created from now on.

name: mv.ignore.nestedselection
description: mv.ignore.nestedselection decides whether a nested selection on a parent table stops a dashboard's filter from being moved up the query tree when StyleBI rewrites a query to run against a materialized view.

name: mv.info.warning
description: mv.info.warning makes the materialized-view query transformer report more about what it did — it records an entry for every selection column moved up the query tree, and stops shortening table names in those reports.

name: mv.max.block
description: mv.max.block is the greatest number of rows a materialized-view block may grow to while StyleBI looks ahead for a break that keeps a distinct-count group whole.

name: mv.merge.deletecond
description: mv.merge.deletecond controls whether the delete condition of an incremental materialized view is merged into the query's pre-conditions, so that rows the incremental update is meant to remove are excluded when the view is rebuilt.

name: mv.metadata
description: mv.metadata is the Use meta-data for editing if MV is not available checkbox in the Materialized View section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > General page — it lets a dashboard open in the Composer against column metadata alone, with no data, when its materialized view could not be created.

name: mv.ondemand
description: mv.ondemand is the Enable MV On-demand checkbox in the Materialized View section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > General page — the server-wide switch that lets StyleBI build a materialized view when a dashboard needs one and none exists.

name: mv.outer.moveup
description: mv.outer.moveup allows a dashboard's selection filter to move up past an outer join — to be applied to the outer table too, rather than only to the side the condition names — when StyleBI rewrites a query to run against a materialized view.

name: mv.preferred.block
description: mv.preferred.block is the target number of rows in one materialized-view block file — the unit StyleBI splits a materialized view into so that blocks can be built and scanned in parallel.

name: mv.required
description: mv.required is the Fail if MV is not available at runtime checkbox in the Materialized View section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > General page — it makes a dashboard whose materialized view is missing fail outright instead of falling back to querying the source data.

name: mv.run.background
description: mv.run.background decides whether the Run in Background checkbox starts ticked on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Content > Materialized Views page and on the MV tab of a dashboard or worksheet under Settings > Content > Repository — that is, whether building materialized views is queued as a background task by default rather than run while the operator waits.

name: mv.table.metadata
description: mv.table.metadata decides how the metadata behind selection lists — the distinct values a selection offers, and their associations — is assembled: by querying the materialized view for each request, or by loading the data once and answering from that.

name: mv.union.moveup
description: mv.union.moveup allows a dashboard's selection filter to be applied to a union of tables as a whole rather than to each table underneath it, when StyleBI rewrites a query to run against a materialized view.

name: mvmanager.dates.ages
description: mvmanager.dates.ages is the Show Dates as Ages checkbox on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Content > Materialized Views page — a per-server display preference, not a per-user one, that switches the last-updated column in the materialized-view list between an absolute date and a relative age (for example, "3 days ago").

name: mysql.local.timezone
description: mysql.local.timezone names the time zone StyleBI converts MySQL date/time values into when mysql.server.timezone is set, and it has no declared default — the JVM's own default time zone is used when it is unset.

name: mysql.server.timezone
description: mysql.server.timezone names the time zone a MySQL server itself stores timestamps in, and it has no declared default; leaving it unset disables StyleBI's time-zone conversion for MySQL date/time SQL functions entirely.

name: olap.cancel.enabled
description: olap.cancel.enabled controls whether StyleBI attempts to cancel an in-flight XMLA (OLAP) request on the remote OLAP server, not just locally, and it has no Enterprise Manager control.

name: olap.drillthrough.maxrows
description: olap.drillthrough.maxrows is the row limit StyleBI puts on a generated OLAP drill-through MDX statement, with no Enterprise Manager control and a declared default of 10.

name: olap.security.enabled
description: olap.security.enabled turns on per-user authentication and cache isolation for OLAP (XMLA) data sources, and has no Enterprise Manager control.

name: olap.table.originalcontent
description: olap.table.originalcontent decides whether OLAP cube member captions display their full, original qualified name or a shortened one, and it defaults to false (shortened).

name: os.name
description: os.name has no declared default and no code path anywhere writes it into StyleBI's property store, so SreeEnv.getProperty("os.name") returns null on every real install.

name: output.null.to.zero
description: output.null.to.zero declares a default of true in defaults.properties, so a bound Output assembly (Gauge, Slider, Thermometer, Cylinder and similar value-display components — not Text or Image) whose query returns no result shows 0 by default, rather than staying blank.

name: pdf.compress.image
description: pdf.compress.image is the Compress Image checkbox under Compress Options on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page, in the PDF Generation section.

name: pdf.compress.text
description: pdf.compress.text is the Compress Text checkbox under Compress Options on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page, in the PDF Generation section.

name: pdf.embed.cmap
description: pdf.embed.cmap is the Embed CMap in PDF checkbox under Font Options on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page, in the PDF Generation section.

name: pdf.embed.font
description: pdf.embed.font is the Embed Font in PDF checkbox under Font Options on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page, in the PDF Generation section.

name: pdf.font.mapping
description: pdf.font.mapping is the Font Mapping table on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page — each row a TrueType Font name and the CID Font name to write in its place — and it has no declared default, so unmapped is the shipped state.

name: pdf.font.ratio
description: pdf.font.ratio corrects the width StyleBI measures for text in a named font, as a ;-separated list of font-name:ratio pairs.

name: pdf.generate.links
description: pdf.generate.links is the Keep Hyperlinks in PDF checkbox under Other Options on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page, in the PDF Generation section.

name: pdf.map.symbols
description: pdf.map.symbols is the Map Symbols checkbox under Font Options on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page, in the PDF Generation section.

name: pdf.open.bookmark
description: pdf.open.bookmark is the Open Bookmark radio option under Other Options on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page, in the PDF Generation section.

name: pdf.open.thumbnail
description: pdf.open.thumbnail is the Open Thumbnail First radio option under Other Options on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page, in the PDF Generation section.

name: pdf.output.ascii
description: pdf.output.ascii is the ASCII Only checkbox under Compress Options on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page, in the PDF Generation section.

name: pdf.output.attachment
description: pdf.output.attachment is the Embed PDF in Browser checkbox under Other Options on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page, in the PDF Generation section.

name: pdf.text.avoidoverlap
description: pdf.text.avoidoverlap limits how tightly StyleBI may squeeze characters together when fitting a string into a PDF, and defaults.properties declares it true.

name: pdf.text.usedefaultcharacterspacing
description: pdf.text.usedefaultcharacterspacing turns off the per-character spacing adjustment StyleBI applies when writing text into a PDF, leaving every string at the font's own metrics, and defaults.properties declares it false.

name: pdf.transcode.jpeg
description: pdf.transcode.jpeg re-encodes a source JPEG through Java's JPEG writer on its way into the PDF, at the compression quality pdf.jpeg.quality names, instead of copying the original file's bytes through untouched.

name: portal.customcss
description: portal.customcss is the URL of a single extra stylesheet StyleBI links from the <head> of every page of the StyleBI application shell — the portal, the Visual Composer, the Viewer, the Wizard and embedded views.

name: portal.customloadinglogo
description: portal.customloadinglogo is the URL of an image shown on the User Portal's loading splash — the screen a user sees between requesting the portal and the application appearing.

name: portal.customloadingtext
description: portal.customloadingtext is the Custom Loading Text field in the Portal Integration section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page — a line of text shown on the User Portal's loading splash, under the built-in Please wait, the application is loading...

name: portal.history.bar
description: portal.history.bar decides whether the User Portal shows the history bar — the strip listing recently opened dashboards — for users who have not chosen for themselves.

name: portal.home.link
description: portal.home.link is the Home Link field in the Portal Integration section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page — where the User Portal's Home button takes the user.

name: portal.logout.url
description: portal.logout.url is where StyleBI sends the browser after a user logs out.

name: qrcode.width
description: qrcode.width has no defaults.properties entry; Abstract2DCodePresenter's constructor falls back to "70" when it is unset.

name: query.analysis.maxrow
description: query.analysis.maxrow is the number of rows the Visualization Recommender samples when suggesting how to chart a dataset.

name: query.cache.data
description: query.cache.data is the Dataset Caching checkbox in the Performance section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > General page — whether StyleBI reuses a query's result set across worksheets and dashboards instead of re-running the query.

name: query.cache.limit
description: query.cache.limit is the Data Cache Size field in the Performance section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > General page — how many query result sets StyleBI keeps cached.

name: query.preview.maxrow
description: query.preview.maxrow is the Query Design Time Maximum Row Count Default field in the Performance section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > General page — the ceiling on rows a query returns for a design-time view rather than for a running dashboard.

name: query.preview.timeout
description: query.preview.timeout is the Query Design Time Timeout [s] field in the Performance section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > General page — the limit, in seconds, on a query run for a design-time view rather than for a running dashboard.

name: query.runtime.timeout
description: query.runtime.timeout is the Query Timeout (s) field in the Performance section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > General page — the server-wide limit, in seconds, on how long a query may run while a dashboard is running.

name: query.variable.unique
description: query.variable.unique decides whether two query variables that share a name are one variable or two.

name: remove.outerjoin.only
