description: remove.outerjoin.only narrows StyleBI's useless-join-table removal so it only ever drops a table that was joined with an outer join, and it is false by default.

name: remove.useless.jointable
description: remove.useless.jointable enables a query-plan optimization that drops tables from a generated SQL query when nothing in the query actually needs them, and it is off by default.

name: replet.browsedata.nocache
description: replet.browsedata.nocache turns off caching of the value lists that populate condition and selection browse dialogs.

name: replet.browsedata.timeout
description: replet.browsedata.timeout is how long a cached browse-data value list may sit unused before it is discarded, in milliseconds — the lists that fill condition and selection browse dialogs.

name: replet.cache.clean
description: replet.cache.clean is the Clean Cache on Startup toggle on Enterprise Manager's Settings > General page, in the Cache card.

name: replet.cache.concurrency
description: replet.cache.concurrency caps the number of report pagination threads ReportCache will run at once.

name: replet.cache.directory
description: replet.cache.directory is the Directory field on Enterprise Manager's Settings > General page, in the Cache card — the filesystem directory the server writes its cache files to.

name: replet.cache.workset
description: replet.cache.workset is how many report pages go in one page group — the unit ReportCache swaps to and from disk.

name: replet.optimize.network
description: replet.optimize.network has no observable effect.

name: replet.repository.file
description: replet.repository.file names the data-space file the repository registry is loaded from and saved to — the folder tree Enterprise Manager renders through ContentRepositoryTreeService.

name: replet.repository.servlet
description: replet.repository.servlet is the base URL the server puts in links it generates — the address it believes clients reach it at, rather than the one a request happened to arrive on.

name: replet.streaming
description: replet.streaming decides whether query results are loaded on a background thread while the caller carries on, or pulled in on the calling thread.

name: report.cache.file.limit
description: report.cache.file.limit has no Enterprise Manager field.

name: report.font
description: report.font has no Enterprise Manager field.

name: report.log.count
description: report.log.count is the BackUp Log File Count field (Enterprise Manager's catalog resolves the label to Number of backup log files) on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Logging page — how many rolled-over copies of the server log file StyleBI keeps once the active file reaches report.log.max, defaulting to 2.

name: report.log.max
description: report.log.max is the Max Log File Size field (Enterprise Manager's catalog resolves the label to Maximum log file size) on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Logging page — the size, in kilobytes, at which StyleBI rolls the server log file over to a new one, defaulting to 10240 (10 MB).

name: report.output.maxpages
description: report.output.maxpages has no Enterprise Manager field.

name: report.stringwidth.fontmetrics
description: report.stringwidth.fontmetrics has no Enterprise Manager field.

name: reportcache.thread.count
description: reportcache.thread.count has no Enterprise Manager field.

name: repository.asset.backup.time
description: repository.asset.backup.time has no Enterprise Manager field: it is the time of day the built-in __asset file backup__ scheduled task is first given, the task the Schedule Backup button in the Data Space section of Settings > General opens.

name: repository.tree.sort
description: repository.tree.sort is the Sort Repository Tree dropdown in the Look & Feel section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page — whether repository and asset trees are ordered A-to-Z or Z-to-A.

name: repository.tree.sort.pathonly
description: repository.tree.sort.pathonly has no Enterprise Manager field: it makes the portal's repository and asset trees sort by each entry's stored name rather than by the alias shown on it.

name: repository.tree.sorter
description: repository.tree.sorter has no Enterprise Manager field: it is the fully qualified name of a java.util.Comparator class that replaces the ordering of the portal's Repository tree.

name: rest.query.timeout.minutes
description: rest.query.timeout.minutes is how many minutes a REST connector waits for an HTTP response before giving up, declared as 30 in defaults.properties, with no Enterprise Manager control.

name: rest.sample.rows
description: rest.sample.rows is the ceiling on how many rows of a connector's data StyleBI is allowed to sample when a query asks for a row-count-limited sample, and it defaults to 20.

name: rmi.localhost.ip
description: rmi.localhost.ip declares a default of false in defaults.properties, so Tool.getRmiIP advertises this server's real network IP address by default.

name: same.site
description: same.site has no defaults.properties entry; all four readers fall back to "Lax" when it is unset.

name: schedule.auto.down
description: schedule.auto.down has no Enterprise Manager field: it decides whether StyleBI stops the scheduler when the server itself shuts down.

name: schedule.auto.start
description: schedule.auto.start has no Enterprise Manager field: it decides whether StyleBI starts the scheduler itself, as a local subprocess, when the server starts.

name: schedule.condition.taskdefaulttime
description: schedule.condition.taskdefaulttime has no Enterprise Manager field: it decides whether the Start Time on a new scheduled task or data cycle is pre-filled with a default, or left empty so the user must enter one.

name: schedule.java.opts
description: schedule.java.opts has no Enterprise Manager field: it is the extra Java command-line options StyleBI passes to the scheduler JVM, declared as an empty value in defaults.properties.

name: schedule.log.file
description: schedule.log.file is the path of the scheduler's log file, shown as Scheduler Log File on Settings > Schedule > Settings and declared as $(sree.home)/schedule.log in defaults.properties.

name: schedule.mail.service
description: schedule.mail.service has no Enterprise Manager field: it is the fully qualified name of a class that replaces StyleBI's built-in delivery of scheduled-task emails.

name: schedule.show.tasks.as.list
description: schedule.show.tasks.as.list is the installation-wide default for whether scheduled tasks are listed flat or shown in the folder tree, on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Schedule > Tasks page and on the portal's Schedule tab.

name: schedule.task.listener
description: schedule.task.listener has no Enterprise Manager field: it is the fully qualified name of a class the scheduler instantiates and notifies at the start and end of every scheduled task.

name: schedule.task.timeout
description: schedule.task.timeout has no Enterprise Manager field: it is the maximum time in milliseconds a scheduled task, or a materialized-view creation, may run before the scheduler cancels it.

name: schedule.time.12hours
description: schedule.time.12hours is the Schedule Time 12 Hours checkbox under Time Settings on Enterprise Manager's Presentation settings page — whether scheduled-task times are shown and entered on a 12-hour clock rather than a 24-hour one — declared false in defaults.properties.

name: schedule.time.ranges
description: schedule.time.ranges is the Time Ranges card on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Schedule > Settings page — the named windows a scheduled task may be assigned to instead of a fixed start time — declared in defaults.properties as Morning 06:00–12:00, Afternoon 12:00–18:00 and Overnight 18:00–06:00, the last marked default.

name: scheduler.restart.auto
description: scheduler.restart.auto has no Enterprise Manager field: it decides whether startServer kills and relaunches an already-running local scheduler subprocess instead of leaving it alone, declared as true in defaults.properties.

name: scheduletask.thread.count
description: scheduletask.thread.count has no declared default; unset, ScheduleTask.getThreadPool falls back to twice the licensed CPU count times three (licenseManager.getAvailableCpuCount()  3  2).

name: script.cursor.top
description: script.cursor.top has no Enterprise Manager field: it decides where the text cursor sits when an author opens StyleBI's script-editor pane — at the very start of the script when true, and at the end of the existing script text when false, which is the defaults.properties value.

name: script.execution.timeout
description: script.execution.timeout has no Enterprise Manager field: it is the number of seconds a single script execution may run in the Graal JavaScript engine before it is interrupted, and defaults.properties declares it as 600 — ten minutes.

name: script.max.errors
description: script.max.errors has no Enterprise Manager field: it caps how many times the same thing may fail before StyleBI stops retrying it.

name: enable.changepassword
description: enable.changepassword decides whether users may change their own password, and defaults to true.

name: login.loginas
description: login.loginas turns on login-as: the ability for an authorised user to authenticate with their own credentials and be logged in as somebody else.

name: secure.cookie
description: secure.cookie marks StyleBI's cookies Secure, so a browser sends them only over HTTPS.

name: security.allow.iframe
description: security.allow.iframe allows StyleBI pages to be embedded in an IFrame on another site, and defaults to false per its security.allow.iframe entry in defaults.properties.

name: security.cache
description: security.cache controls the authentication provider's identity cache and defaults to true per its security.cache entry in defaults.properties.

name: security.datasource.everyone
description: security.datasource.everyone decides whether data sources, data model and query folders, queries and cubes with no explicit grant are readable by everyone, and falls back to true when unset.

name: security.enablecontenttypeoptions
description: security.enablecontenttypeoptions has no Enterprise Manager field: it decides whether StyleBI adds the X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff header to every HTTP response, and it is false unless set, so the header is absent on a stock install.

name: security.enabled
description: security.enabled decides whether StyleBI authenticates and authorises anyone at all, and is unset by default, which counts as off.

name: security.enablexssprotection
description: security.enablexssprotection has no Enterprise Manager field: it decides whether StyleBI adds the X-XSS-Protection: 1 header to every HTTP response, and it is false unless set, so the header is absent on a stock install.

name: security.googlesignin.enabled
description: security.googlesignin.enabled turns on the Sign In With Google button and the OpenID SSO filter behind it, and defaults to true per its entry in defaults.properties.

name: security.login.orglocation
description: security.login.orglocation says where in a request StyleBI looks for the organization being signed in to — the host name or the URL path — and falls back to domain when unset.

name: security.provider
description: security.provider is a legacy flag telling older code paths that security is configured, and defaults to the empty string per its entry in defaults.properties.

name: security.robotstag
description: security.robotstag has no Enterprise Manager field: it is the value StyleBI sends in the X-Robots-Tag header on every HTTP response, and unlike its two siblings it is on by default — noindex, nofollow, which asks search engines not to index the application.

name: security.scheduletask.everyone
description: security.scheduletask.everyone decides whether a schedule task folder with no explicit permission grant is readable by everyone, and falls back to true when unset.

name: security.script.everyone
description: security.script.everyone decides whether script functions and the script library with no explicit grant are readable by everyone, and falls back to true when unset.

name: security.selfsignup.enabled
description: security.selfsignup.enabled lets a visitor who is not already a StyleBI user create an account, and defaults to false per its security.selfsignup.enabled entry in defaults.properties.

name: security.tablestyle.everyone
description: security.tablestyle.everyone decides whether table styles and the table style library with no explicit grant are readable by everyone, and falls back to true when unset.

name: security.user.casesensitive
description: security.user.casesensitive decides whether the database security provider matches user names and organization IDs case-sensitively, and falls back to true when it is unset.

name: security.users.multitenant
description: security.users.multitenant makes the server host several organizations, not one, and falls back to false when unset.

name: selectionlist.maxrow
description: selectionlist.maxrow declares a default of 50000 in defaults.properties.

name: server.type
description: server.type identifies the deployment mode of the current StyleBI server node, and every subsystem that reads it checks specifically for the value server_cluster; it is empty by default.

name: share.email.enabled
description: share.email.enabled is the Enable sharing in email checkbox in the Social Sharing section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page — it decides whether a user may mail a link to a dashboard from the share menu.

name: share.facebook.enabled
description: share.facebook.enabled is the Enable sharing with Facebook checkbox in the Social Sharing section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page — it decides whether the Facebook entry of a dashboard's share menu can be used.

name: share.googlechat.enabled
description: share.googlechat.enabled is the Enable sharing in Google Hangouts Chat room checkbox in the Social Sharing section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page — it decides whether a user may post a link to a dashboard into a Google Chat room from the share menu.

name: share.link.enabled
description: share.link.enabled is the Enable copying link for embedding checkbox in the Social Sharing section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page — it decides whether the Copy Link entry of a dashboard's share menu can be used, which opens a dialog offering the dashboard's URL and an HTML snippet for embedding it in a page.

name: share.linkedin.enabled
description: share.linkedin.enabled is the Enable sharing with LinkedIn checkbox in the Social Sharing section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page — it decides whether the LinkedIn entry of a dashboard's share menu can be used.

name: share.opengraph.description
description: share.opengraph.description is the Open Graph Description field in the Social Sharing section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page — the fallback og:description meta tag StyleBI puts in the portal page's <head>, which is the summary line a social network shows under the headline when someone posts a dashboard link.

name: share.opengraph.image
description: share.opengraph.image is the Open Graph Image URL field in the Social Sharing section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page — the og:image meta tag StyleBI puts in the portal page's <head>, which is the thumbnail a social network shows on the preview when someone posts a dashboard link.

name: share.opengraph.sitename
description: share.opengraph.sitename is the Open Graph Site Name field in the Social Sharing section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page — the og:site_name meta tag StyleBI puts in the portal page's <head>, which is the site name a social network shows above the preview when someone posts a dashboard link.

name: share.opengraph.title
description: share.opengraph.title is the Open Graph Title field in the Social Sharing section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page — the fallback og:title meta tag StyleBI puts in the portal page's <head>, which is the headline a social network shows on the preview when someone posts a dashboard link.

name: share.slack.enabled
description: share.slack.enabled is the Enable sharing in Slack channel checkbox in the Social Sharing section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page — it decides whether a user may post a link to a dashboard into a Slack channel from the share menu.

name: share.twitter.enabled
description: share.twitter.enabled is the Enabled sharing with Twitter checkbox in the Social Sharing section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page — it decides whether the Twitter entry of a dashboard's share menu can be used.

name: show.license.exception
description: show.license.exception has no declared default; unset, LicenseException suppresses its own stack trace everywhere it would normally be printed.

name: selfsignuppost.header
description: selfsignuppost.header is the name of an extra HTTP header StyleBI adds when posting a record of a newly self-registered user to selfsignuppost.url, carrying selfsignuppost.secretkey as its value.

name: selfsignuppost.url
description: selfsignuppost.url is the endpoint StyleBI posts a record of each newly self-registered user to, and has no declared default.

name: selfsignuppost.username
description: selfsignuppost.username is the user name StyleBI presents in HTTP Basic authentication when posting a record of a newly self-registered user to selfsignuppost.url, and has no declared default.

name: signup.mail.from.address
description: signup.mail.from.address is the From address on the verification-code email StyleBI sends to a visitor signing themselves up, and has no declared default.

name: signup.mail.message
description: signup.mail.message is the body of the verification-code email StyleBI sends to a visitor signing themselves up, and has no Enterprise Manager control.

name: signup.mail.subject
description: signup.mail.subject is the Subject line of the verification-code email StyleBI sends to a visitor signing themselves up, and defaults to Your Inetsoft StyleBI verification code.

name: single.preview.enabled
description: single.preview.enabled has no declared default; unset, a Composer worksheet may have more than one preview worksheet open against it at once.

name: sort.crosstab.aggregate
description: sort.crosstab.aggregate sets whether a viewsheet crosstab's binding model reports its aggregate (measure) columns as sortable by header click, and it is false by default.

name: sort.crosstab.dimension
description: sort.crosstab.dimension sets whether a viewsheet crosstab's binding model reports its dimension columns as sortable by header click, and it is true by default.

name: sql.format
description: sql.format has no defaults.properties entry; SQLHelper falls back to "true" when it is unset, so generated SQL is pretty-printed across multiple lines by default.

name: sree.bundle
description: sree.bundle has no Enterprise Manager field: it names the base resource bundle StyleBI's Catalog.REPORT catalog type loads its localized strings from, declared as SreeBundle in defaults.properties.

name: sree.collator
description: sree.collator has no Enterprise Manager field: it names a java.text.Collator subclass to instantiate by reflection for string comparisons, declared as an empty string in defaults.properties.

name: sreebundle
description: sreebundle has no defaults.properties entry, but its own accessor call supplies its name back as its default, so it effectively defaults to the literal string "SreeBundle" — the name of StyleBI's own base resource bundle (Catalog.DEFAULT_BUNDLE).

name: sro.debug.max
description: sro.debug.max has no declared default; unset, or set to an empty string, a legacy report's Table element displays every row of the TableLens it is bound to.

name: string.compare.casesensitive
description: string.compare.casesensitive declares a default of false in defaults.properties, so string values are compared case-insensitively unless changed, taking effect on the very next comparison.

name: stylereport.chart.painter
description: stylereport.chart.painter names a custom ChartPainter implementation class to use when rendering a legacy StyleReport-format chart element, and it has no declared default.

name: stylereport.locale.resource
description: stylereport.locale.resource names the base resource bundle StyleBI's built-in StyleReport catalog loads its translated text from, and it is inetsoft/util/srinter by default.

name: swappable.alive.period
description: swappable.alive.period has no Enterprise Manager field.

name: swapper.count
description: swapper.count has no Enterprise Manager field.

name: table.cachedcell.threshold
description: table.cachedcell.threshold has no Enterprise Manager field: it bounds the size of a per-table cache TablePaintable keeps while laying out wrapped cell text for print and PDF output, clearing the cache once it grows past the threshold.

name: table.export.cell.threshold.forcetocsv
description: table.export.cell.threshold.forcetocsv has no Enterprise Manager field: it forces the Export Data action on a viewsheet table, or a worksheet table export, to CSV once the table's cell count — rows times columns — exceeds the configured number.

name: table.export.format
description: table.export.format has no Enterprise Manager field: it forces the Export Data action on a viewsheet table, or a worksheet table export, to produce a CSV file instead of an Excel workbook.

name: table.export.hiddencolumns
description: table.export.hiddencolumns has no Enterprise Manager field: it decides whether the Export Data action on a viewsheet table includes columns the table has hidden by width.

name: table.mergedcell.repeat
description: table.mergedcell.repeat has no Enterprise Manager field: it decides whether a merged (spanned) table cell's content repeats at the top of every page it spans, when a report or print/PDF output paginates a table.

name: table.output.maxcol
description: table.output.maxcol has no Enterprise Manager field: it caps how many columns of a viewsheet table are rendered in the web viewer and in PDF/SVG/print-layout export, clamped between 1 and 500.

name: table.output.maxrow
description: table.output.maxrow is the Table Maximum Row Count field in the Performance section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > General page.

name: text.encoding.export
description: text.encoding.export names the character encoding StyleBI writes a CSV export in — unset by default, in which case its sibling text.encoding.utf8 decides the effective encoding instead.

name: text.encoding.utf8
description: text.encoding.utf8 picks the fallback character encoding for a CSV export when text.encoding.export itself is not set — true by default, so a CSV export encodes as UTF-8 unless either property says otherwise.

name: text.wordwrap.122
description: text.wordwrap.122 — named after the issue it was added for, not a byte or character count — turns on a breakAll flag when building a Text viewsheet assembly's model, unset (off) by default.

name: textbox.shadow.width
description: textbox.shadow.width has no defaults.properties entry; TextPainter's hardcoded field default of 4 applies when it is unset.

name: ucc128.application.identifier
description: ucc128.application.identifier declares a default of "report" in defaults.properties.

name: user.name
description: user.name is a StyleBI property store key — distinct from the identically-named JVM system property — read only by PDF3PrinterJob.getUserName, the print-job requestor name StyleBI reports through the standard java.awt.print.PrinterJob API when a report is rendered via that job.

name: viewer.locale
description: viewer.locale declares an empty default in defaults.properties, so an empty or unset value falls through to the JVM's own default locale.

name: viewsheet.chart.adhoc
description: viewsheet.chart.adhoc sets the initial state of Enable Ad Hoc Editing on the Advanced tab of a dashboard chart's property dialog.

name: viewsheet.font.size
description: viewsheet.font.size sets the default font size dashboard assemblies are created with, either as an absolute point size or as a relative adjustment.

name: viewsheet.hyperlink.singleclick
description: viewsheet.hyperlink.singleclick makes a click on a table, crosstab or Freehand Table cell that has exactly one hyperlink follow that link straight away, instead of opening the one-item menu that would otherwise list it.

name: viewsheet.maxrows.warning.text
description: viewsheet.maxrows.warning.text supplies the Max Rows Warning checkbox on a dashboard's options pane for stored dashboards that do not carry that setting themselves.

name: viewsheet.user.instance.limit
description: viewsheet.user.instance.limit caps how many dashboards one login session may have open at once.

name: viewsheet.viewer.advancedfeatures
description: viewsheet.viewer.advancedfeatures puts the Conditions… and Highlight… actions on dashboard assemblies in the viewer, where they are otherwise absent.

name: viewsheet.virtual.scroll
description: viewsheet.virtual.scroll makes the viewer render a dashboard assembly only once it has been scrolled into view, rather than rendering all of them up front.

name: vs.annotation.cleanup.interval
description: vs.annotation.cleanup.interval is how many days an annotation survives, since it was last carried forward, before StyleBI drops it from its dashboard's saved state.

name: vs.auto.refresh.enabled
description: vs.auto.refresh.enabled decides whether the Server-Side Update checkbox in the composer's Viewsheet Property dialog can be operated at all.

name: vs.bookmark.button
description: vs.bookmark.button is the Bookmark checkbox in the Dashboard Toolbar Options section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page.

name: vs.close.button
description: vs.close.button is the Close checkbox in the Dashboard Toolbar Options section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page.

name: vs.crosstab.keepspan
description: vs.crosstab.keepspan keeps the merged header cells of a crosstab intact when the crosstab is sorted.

name: vs.crosstab.sortonheader
description: vs.crosstab.sortonheader puts sorting controls on a crosstab's header cells in the viewer.

name: vs.edit.button
description: vs.edit.button is the Edit checkbox in the Dashboard Toolbar Options section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page.

name: vs.email.button
description: vs.email.button is the Email checkbox in the Dashboard Toolbar Options section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page.

name: vs.export.button
description: vs.export.button is the Export checkbox in the Dashboard Toolbar Options section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page.

name: vs.font.asdefault
description: vs.font.asdefault makes a table use the dashboard's default font in place of the font its table style supplies.

name: vs.form.enabled
description: vs.form.enabled switches off form tables and everything that depends on them.

name: vs.fullscreen.button
description: vs.fullscreen.button is the Full Screen checkbox in the Dashboard Toolbar Options section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page.

name: vs.import.button
description: vs.import.button is the Import checkbox in the Dashboard Toolbar Options section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page.

name: vs.next.button
description: vs.next.button is the Redo checkbox in the Dashboard Toolbar Options section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page.

name: vs.previous.button
description: vs.previous.button is the Undo checkbox in the Dashboard Toolbar Options section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page.

name: vs.print.button
description: vs.print.button is the Print checkbox in the Dashboard Toolbar Options section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page.

name: vs.refresh.button
description: vs.refresh.button is the Refresh checkbox in the Dashboard Toolbar Options section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page.

name: vs.schedule.button
description: vs.schedule.button is the Schedule checkbox in the Dashboard Toolbar Options section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page.

name: vs.share.button
description: vs.share.button is the Social Sharing checkbox in the Dashboard Toolbar Options section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page.

name: vs.zoom
description: vs.zoom is the Zoom checkbox in the Dashboard Toolbar Options section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page.

name: wallboarding.enabled
description: wallboarding.enabled has no declared default; unset, a viewsheet session times out normally after its usual inactivity period even when auto-refresh is on.

name: warning.position.onheader
description: warning.position.onheader has no declared default; unset, a legacy report's rendering-warning indicator (for example, an element that overflowed its space) is placed near the bottom of the printed page.

name: weblogic.cp.host
description: weblogic.cp.host has no Enterprise Manager field: it is the host name or IP address of the WebLogic server whose JNDI tree StyleBI looks JDBC data sources up in, defaulting to localhost.

name: weblogic.cp.port
description: weblogic.cp.port has no Enterprise Manager field: it is the port of the WebLogic server whose JNDI tree StyleBI looks JDBC data sources up in, defaulting to 7001, WebLogic's own default listen port.

name: webmap.default
description: webmap.default is the Use Web Map By Default checkbox in the Web Map section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page, and it has no declared default, which PlotDescriptor's field initialiser treats as false: a chart's own webMap field starts false unless the property is exactly "true" at the moment that chart's PlotDescriptor is constructed.

name: webmap.service
description: webmap.service is the Web Map Service toggle in the Web Map section of Enterprise Manager's Settings > Presentation page, choosing which tile-image provider StyleBI uses to render a chart as a real geographic web map: mapbox or googlemaps (the EM control's third option, None, is not a stored value — it is simply an unset property).

name: webmap.suspend.until
description: webmap.suspend.until is an epoch-millisecond timestamp StyleBI itself sets to temporarily disable web-map rendering after a Mapbox or Google Maps quota error, and it has no declared default and no Enterprise Manager field — it is not an operator setting.

name: week.start
description: week.start declares an empty default in defaults.properties, so which day a week starts on falls back to the current locale's own convention until an operator sets it.

name: wiz.agent.pairing.enabled
description: wiz.agent.pairing.enabled is the off-by-default gate on the wiz sheet-agent pairing capability — the mechanism by which an agent joins a live editing session on a sheet.

name: wiz.agent.script.require.script.pane
description: wiz.agent.script.require.script.pane tightens how narrowly a wiz agent session must be paired before it may act on a script.

name: wiz.auth.enabled
description: wiz.auth.enabled decides whether WizServiceAuthenticationFilter validates the JWT bearer token that the wiz service presents.

name: wiz.service.url
description: wiz.service.url is the address of the wiz service.

name: ws.export.page.max.cell
description: ws.export.page.max.cell caps how many cells a single Excel sheet gets when exporting a worksheet to Excel, and it is 500000 by default.

name: ws.mv.enabled
description: ws.mv.enabled decides whether worksheets are eligible for materialized-view (MV) creation and analysis at all, and it is off by default.
